<!--
Thanks for taking the time to report a bug! Please fill out the sections
below so maintainers can reproduce and fix it quickly.

For **security vulnerabilities**, please do NOT use this form — report
them privately per our [Security Policy](SECURITY.md).
-->

## Describe the bug

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. Scroll down to '...'
4. See error

## Expected behavior

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Actual behavior

What actually happened. Include error messages, stack traces, or HTTP
status codes if relevant.

## Screenshots / logs

If applicable, add screenshots or relevant log output to help explain the
problem. **Redact any API keys or secrets before pasting** — never share
credentials in issues or pull requests (see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)).

## Environment

- Deployment: Docker Compose / local dev / other
- Backend version: `main` / tag / `git rev-parse HEAD`
- LLM provider: OpenAI / Ollama / Groq / DeepSeek
- Frontend: built from `main` / npm build
- Browser & OS: (e.g. Chrome 126 on macOS 14)
- Database: PostgreSQL / SQLite (dev)

## Additional context

- Did this work before? If so, what changed?
- Is this related to a known task in [docs/ROADMAP.md](../../docs/ROADMAP.md)?
- Anything else that might help us diagnose the issue.
